# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Swamp Ogrely Ever After** as a browser-native mobile portrait top-down free-roam parody adventure. Preserve the existing mechanics: left-thumb movement, grab/claim one nearby item, attack with the held item or bare hands, enemies pursue and damage on contact, defeated enemies award score and can spawn items, hearts/HP produce game over, and discovered items persist in an index. Present the world as a swampy fairy-tale spoof with a green antihero, cursed junk collectibles, crown-wearing pests, rude mud props, pop-comedy callouts, and touch-friendly HUD/controls for 4:7 to 9:16 portrait screens.

Primary steering prompt: Shrek fairy-tale parody adventure. A Shrek fairy-tale parody adventure game with swampy irreverence, oddball friendship, anti-princess humor, pop-culture jokes, chaotic charm, and lovable gross-out fantasy with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
- genre: mobile-first top-down free-roam arcade adventure with collection and light combat.
- objective: roam a bounded overworld, claim nearby items, discover up to 60 collection entries, defeat pursuing enemies for score, and survive while HP remains.
- input model: left virtual joystick or WASD/arrow movement; separate CLAIM/GRAB and STRIKE/BONK touch buttons plus keyboard equivalents.
- core loop: spawn in world, collect/hold one weapon-like item, attack approaching enemies, gain score on kills, discover collection entries, survive increasing enemy pressure, restart after HP reaches zero.
- fail/friction state: contact with enemies removes hearts/HP; zero HP opens a game-over overlay with final score and restart/menu CTAs.

## Protected mechanics
- Free-roam movement speed/friction, bounded world/camera, joystick and keyboard semantics, claim radius, single held item behavior, attack cone/cooldown/reach/damage, enemy pursuit/contact damage, score-on-kill, randomized item spawning, discovery persistence, game-over and restart flow are preserved.

## Safe transformation surfaces
HUD copy, title, collection names, rarity labels, procedural canvas drawing, background motifs, entity silhouettes, CSS palette, fonts, overlays, button language, particles, audio source choices, and progression framing are themable because they do not alter loop truth.

## Remix target
Shrek fairy-tale parody adventure. A Shrek fairy-tale parody adventure game with swampy irreverence, oddball friendship, anti-princess humor, pop-culture jokes, chaotic charm, and lovable gross-out fantasy with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range. The rebuilt game maps the same mechanics to a swamp antihero protecting muddy home turf from smug fairy-tale pests while collecting cursed junk for a Gross-Out Almanac.
